{{Top|leg}}
'''Neena Garnet''' was a [[Socorran]]<ref name="Uncivilized">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> gunfighter and the [[Gender/Legends|sister]] of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]. She owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' until she was killed<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga, Part 2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 2: Unsung Heroes of the Light}}</ref> by notorious [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] gunfighter [[Uul-Rha-Shan]]<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> in the [[Black Sands Cantina]] over a bar tab,<ref name="Uncivilized" /> at which point the ship was inherited by her brother.<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga, Part 2" />
